intro.text: Beep-boop! Welcome to Mars, {name}! I'm LUNA, your helper drone.
A big dust storm hit our base. The solar panels are dusty and the radio dish is broken.
Earth can't hear us! Let's fix Outpost 7, one step at a time, and then CALL HOME.
Walk with WASD or the arrow keys. Press E to use things. Follow the glowing yellow path on the ground!

missions.title: First Steps on Red Soil
missions.summary: Suit up safely and brush the dust off the solar panels.
missions.lesson: Dust blocks sunlight. Dirty solar panels make less power — the Opportunity rover once got a big boost when the wind blew its panels clean!

briefing.text: Mission 1! Red dust covers our solar panels, so they make almost no power.
Go to the AIRLOCK (bottom-left room) and press E. Astronauts always do a safety check first.
Outside, stand by a solar panel and press E to brush it clean.

objectives.hint: The Airlock is the bottom-left room of the base. Stand by the yellow-striped door and press E.
The solar panels are just below the base. Stand next to one and press E.
Walk back to the airlock door and press E.

complete.text: Woo-hoo! Clean panels catch more sunlight, so we get more POWER!
Real fact: little whirlwinds once blew the dust off NASA's Mars rovers!

missions.title: Power to the Outpost
missions.summary: Fix the power unit and switch on the greenhouse lights.
missions.lesson: Every machine needs power, but the Sun only gives so much. Engineers choose what gets power first — that's a trade-off!

briefing.text: Mission 2! The storm jumbled the wires in our Power Unit, the PDU.
The PDU is the yellow box in the COMMAND room. Press E and match the wires.
Then use the Mission Console to switch the Greenhouse lights ON.

objectives.hint: The PDU is the yellow box with sparks on the top wall of the Command room. Press E next to it.

objectives.text: Open Base Ops at the Mission Console
objectives.hint: The Mission Console is the big screen in the Command Module. Press E there.
In Base Ops, press the big ON button for Greenhouse Lights.

complete.text: Power is flowing! You're a real power engineer.
At night there is no sun. Then the battery keeps the base running until morning.

missions.title: Ice, Ice, Mars-y
missions.summary: Scan for buried ice, dig it up and melt it into water.
missions.lesson: Mars has lots of water — but it's frozen underground! Robots like Phoenix dug up real Martian ice in 2008.

briefing.text: Mission 3! Our water tank is low, but there is ICE hiding under the soil!
Go outside and press the SCAN button. Buried ice will glow blue.
Hold the mouse on the blue ground to dig it up, then bring it home and melt it.

objectives.hint: You must be outside. Press the SCAN button (or Q).
Glowing blue ground has ice. Pick the Mining Laser in your tool bar and hold the mouse on it.

objectives.text: Bring the ice back to the base
objectives.hint: Walk back in through the airlock. Your backpack empties by itself.

objectives.text: Switch ON the Ice Melter in Base Ops
objectives.hint: At the Mission Console, press ON for the Ice Melter.
Keep the Ice Melter ON. Hold the FAST button to speed things up!

complete.text: Splash! Fresh water from Martian ice. Water is the most important thing on Mars!
Astronauts on the Space Station recycle almost all their water, even sweat!

missions.title: Split It or Sip It?
missions.summary: Share the water: oxygen to breathe, or water for the plants?
missions.lesson: Water can be split into oxygen to breathe, or given to plants to grow food. A good base needs BOTH, so you choose the balance.

briefing.text: Mission 4! Water can become OXYGEN to breathe, or help PLANTS grow food.
Plant 3 seeds in the Greenhouse trays. Stand by a tray and press E.
Then slide the WATER VALVE in Base Ops so the plants get a drink.

objectives.hint: The Greenhouse is in the middle of the base. Stand by an empty tray and press E.

objectives.text: Set the Water Valve in Base Ops
objectives.hint: At the Mission Console, open the WATER tab and drag the slider.
Ripe plants sparkle. Press E next to them. Hold FAST to make them grow quicker!

complete.text: Fresh air AND fresh food! You balanced the water like a NASA engineer.
Fun fact: NASA's MOXIE machine made real oxygen on Mars!

missions.title: Solar Storm Shelter
missions.summary: A solar flare is coming! Build shielding and take cover.
missions.lesson: Mars has no global magnetic field and a thin atmosphere, so space radiation reaches the ground. Thick walls of regolith or water block it.

briefing.text: SPACE WEATHER ALERT! A big flare on the Sun is sending radiation to Mars.
Let's make the Storm Shelter wall thicker. Build bricks at the Fabricator.
Then go outside to the RIGHT side of the base and click the 8 glowing squares.
When the flare comes, hide inside the Storm Shelter room. I'll warn you!

objectives.hint: The Fabricator is the 3D printer in the Algae Lab. Press E there and pick BUILD.

objectives.text: Fill all 8 shield slots by the shelter wall
objectives.hint: Go to the RIGHT side of the base. Click each glowing square while holding bricks.

objectives.text: Ride out the solar flare in the shelter
objectives.hint: When the red alert starts, go into the Storm Shelter room (bottom-right) and wait.

complete.text: The flare is over and you're safe! Thick walls blocked the radiation.
NASA's Curiosity rover measures radiation on Mars to help design shelters like yours.

missions.title: Call Home
missions.summary: Drive the rover, collect antenna parts, fix the dish and contact Earth.
missions.lesson: Radio signals travel at the speed of light, but Mars is so far away that a message takes between 3 and 22 minutes to reach Earth!

briefing.text: Final mission! Fix the big radio dish and CALL EARTH.
The storm scattered 3 dish parts far away. Take the ROVER and follow the glowing yellow path.
The rover is parked left of the base. Press E to hop in. GO HOME drives you back!

objectives.hint: The rover is parked on the pad to the LEFT of the base. Press E next to it.
Follow the glowing yellow path. Just touch the glowing parts.
The dish is far up and to the right. Open the MAP to see it.
Stand next to the antenna and press E.
Press E at the antenna again and turn the dish toward the blue Earth.

complete.text: Outpost 7, this is Mission Control. We hear you loud and clear! Great work, {name}!
We did it! We can talk to Earth again!

bounties.text: Plant {n} explorer flags far from base
Mine {n} olivine crystals (try the lava tube cave)
Dig {n} pits with the Mining Laser

graduation.text: Mission Control here. Outpost 7 has power, water, air, food, a shelter and a radio!
You graduated, {name}! You're a Junior Astronaut. Here is your certificate!
Mission Control will send BONUS JOBS in the top-right corner. Keep exploring!
